description: Fetches a website (crawling multiple pages) and scores how well it works with, and defends against, AI agents. Runs nine checks: hidden prompt injection text, llms.txt, the robots.txt stance on AI crawlers, structured data, accountability links, sitemap, content structured for AI answers, accidental index blocking, and whether an agent endpoint (such as MCP) is advertised. Returns a score out of 100, a letter grade, and a finding for each check with a suggested fix.

url.description: The site to audit, as a bare domain (example.com) or full URL

name: audit_site
title: Audit a website for AI agent readiness
